The '''Bartyn mansion''' was the home of the [[Bartyn family]] in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], which was almost completely controlled by them. It was located in [[Mt. Hugo]], the highest mountain of the [[Krakana's Maw]] range, near the city of [[Bartyn's Landing]].

Besides the city itself, the Bartyn mansion was the biggest artificial structure in the planet. It was built with red wood from local [[vaffu tree]] as if it was the stronghold of a warlord, although it used advanced technology and [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]] guards for defense. It was also heavily decorated without being vulgar.

As of c. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], it was the residence of [[Administrator (ORO)|ORO Administrator]] [[Guther Bartyn]].
